% 22.03.2023 Exemption allowed subject to just exceptions. W.P.(CRL) 2837/2022 1.

This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No.366/2022 registered at PS Vasant Kunj North under Sections 376/328/313 IPC on the ground that the petitioner/accused and respondent No.2/complainant are now married and living together.
Both petitioner and respondent No.2 are present through VC and duly identified by the respective counsels and the IO and confirm the status of the marriage.
They got married in Amritsar on 21st September, 2022 and a marriage certificate has been placed on record.

Respondent No.2 states on affidavit which is also on record of this Court that the complaint was filed because of miscommunication and misunderstanding with the petitioner who has now fulfilled his promise and has married her on 20th September, 2022 and they are living happily as husband and wife.

2. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.
Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, the FIR No.366/2022 registered at PS Vasant Kunj North under Sections 376/328/313 IPC and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
3. Parties shall abide by the terms of settlement.
4. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of.
Pending applications (if any) are disposed of as infructuous.
5. Next date 30th May, 2023 stands cancelled.
